body.content: Alternative framing: what if there is no single dominant cross-city modulator? The energy balance has multiple terms (thermal mass, SVF, evapotranspiration, anthropogenic heat, wind), and their relative contributions vary by climate, city size, and building density. A unified answer would be a conditional one: 'it depends on X.' But the question asks for a single mechanism, so perhaps the best answer is the one with the most universal explanatory power across diverse city contexts.
body.why_keep_this: This is the unifier's stance (SRC_003) and provides an atypical but defensible answer.
